title: Can an AI-assisted game have soul?
author: tintwotin
selftext:
Can you allow yourself to be emotionally engaged in a game if the development process has been AI-assisted? Interesting discussion on my latest game, an updated-to-present-times and gamified version of the novel "1984". What do you think?   
  
Are we at a tipping point, where the knee-jerk anti-ai movement will have to surrender to ai-assisted works (if they're good enough)?   
  
This is the game in question: [https://tintwotin.itch.io/twenty-thirty](https://tintwotin.itch.io/twenty-thirty)

comments.author: luckily_unknown
comments.body:
Honestly, i've always thought that it doesn't matter if is AI assisted or AI made (entirely) or Hand-made. It just matter what comes out of process.
The only thing that separates you from a complete lazy fuck who wants to have a 1 day made game, is your taste (with every aspect you'll have in mind).
And the taste persists, whetever you're doing with your project.

replies.author: MatsutakeShinji
replies.body: AI generated manga already sells well in Japan

comments.author: OfflinePen
comments.body: I love how it's just "if it's not AI it's good" then "if it's AI it's bad" anti are just a bunch of donkeys

comments.author: MatsutakeShinji
comments.body: Why not? I mostly consider it for code generation

comments.author: Hanfkeks_
comments.body:
To be fair, AI can be same-y when prompted lazily.
Examples:
- Midjourney Girl
- GPT's default comic style
- AI Storytelling where it just makes shit up on the spot without a storytelling goal

replies.author: Hanfkeks_
replies.body:
That doesn't mean everything AI is inherently worse btw. People just start to realize that kind of content is AI and think all AI content is like this. They're also emotionally charged for various reasons (autistic inability/refusal to adapt to new situations, "AI is better at my hobby than me" frustration, fear of displacement in the job or even apocalyptic fears).

I think the most important thing is to finetune it so it's not sloppy

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: Plenty of autistic people are very happy with AI. It helps us communicate as if we are normal people.

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body:
This is why "prompt engineering" is a thing, even though every moron calls himself a prompt engineer now.

It's not exclusive to AI though. All art is made by artists, but anyone can call themselves an artist.

comments.author: tintwotin
comments.body: For me, the main difference is if there is someone behind the work, who has used an artistic explorative process to engage the player/receiver/audience emotionally in a dialogue.

comments.author: Other-Football72
comments.body:
I think of AI kind of like CGI in movies.

When done well, or ways to enhance things - not bad. When overused or cheap? Ugh. 

I think the best approach is to do as much without it as you can and use it when it makes sense. If every single bit of art in a game is AI-generated? You may end up with the stink of AI on it, which is off putting to many (myself included).

comments.author: atx78701
comments.body:
as you said, digital art when it first appeared, people claimed it had no soul, it lacked the warmth of analog mediums. They said the same thing about photographs. 

AI is a tool that will allow more people try to create art (just like digital art did). You can invest less time in the mechanics of making art and more time in the outcome.  Because more people are doing it, orders of magnitude more trash will be created, but there will be people who create amazing stuff that could have before.

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body:
This is a common cope I believe by the people to lazy to actually learn about AI and they are ones to typically jump on any hate bandwagon thats currently popular. Its pretty sheep like mentality in my opinion. 

But hey at least it cuts down on competition because it's getting to the point where if you aren't learning about AI / LLMs at a serious level you are most likely going to fall behind in the grand scheme of things. 

Don't be like your parents in terms of how they treated the internet and technology. Stay educated and stay ahead of the game 💪
